headline: Cherki left out of predicted starting XI
body: The Standard, 17 Oct 2026: Rayan Cherki was taken off at half-time against PSG and may make way here, with Phil Foden waiting for a chance. Cherki left out of the predicted starting XI (Foden preferred). Predicted XI: Donnarumma; Nunes, Dias, Guehi, O’Reilly; Bouaddi, Fernandez; Semenyo, Foden, Ndiaye; Haaland.
